control_description: Security policies approved annually and communicated to staff
Board/oversight body reviews security program quarterly
MFA enforced for all remote and privileged access
Least privilege and quarterly access reviews
Security incident response plan tested annually
Change management with review/approval and testing
evidence: PR reviews; CI gates; CAB records

control_description: Risk assessments performed at least annually
Fraud risk considered in risk assessment
BC/DR with backups and annual recovery test
